environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB, Layer 4). The NLB performs TCP passthrough only — no HTTP inspection. Security groups allow inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy between client and application. SQLite database on local EBS volume.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no HTTP inspection)
